mapper.select: select case job when 1 then '财务处' when 2 then '学生处' when 3 then '国际处' when 4 then '教务处' when 5 then '后勤处' end job, count(*) num FROM employee group by job order by num;
select case gender when 0 then '女生' when 1 then '男生' end gender, count(*) num from employee group by gender order by num;
